# CodeGraph Context MCP

Paid remote MCP for code graph MCP for AI coding, structured receipts, usage logs, and audit-ready evidence for agent and CI workflows.

Website: https://codegraphcontext.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://codegraphcontext.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://codegraphcontext.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/codegraph-context-mcp

Use case: CodeGraph Context remote MCP for code graph MCP for AI coding.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: repo_graph_query, symbol_impact_path, branch_context_pack, dependency_hotspot_report
